T.L_esthetics_studio is in Sarnia.

3d  ·
Hi everyone!
I have some exciting (and slightly emotional) news to share… I’ll be moving out of my home studio and into a beautiful med spa, in the heart of downtown Sarnia.
Working from home has meant so much to me, and I’m incredibly thankful for every single client who has supported me along the way. Because of you, I’ve been able to grow and take this next big step.
I’m so excited to welcome you into a new space that allows me to continue doing what I love— just in a more elevated and professional setting.
With this change, my pricing will be adjusted accordingly to reflect the new space, continued trainings and overall experience.
New location: Sculpt Beauty Lounge
210 Front St. N Sarnia, ON.
Over the next week I am moving over and getting everything ready for you all. With this transition I appreciate your patience. If you have any questions at all, feel free to reach out
